text1: Please arrive by 9:45, for a 10am start. Any latecomers will have to wait outside until the ceremony is over. We don't want to you to miss it!
text2: After the ceremony, we'll head to the Overground station to catch the quick train to our final destination. The Spread Eagle Pub!
text3: We arrive at our lovely venue for lunch, cake, drinks and some light hearted fun.
text4: We hope you have a wonderful time and enjoyed our little celebration!
